query.epsilon_justification: no tangency false negative was demonstrated at epsilon 0, so none was introduced. Measured boundary convention is TOUCH.

collision_filtering: none. Any collider PhysX reports is blocking; no name or semantic filtering.
instance_proxy_semantics: PhysX scene queries operate on the physics scene, so instanced and referenced colliders are resolved. Validated: the instanced-collider fixture agrees exactly (4/4).

unknown_cell_policy.query_failure: a cell whose query raises is BLOCKED and counted in occupancy_query_failures
unknown_cell_policy.rationale: the opposite convention made 54% of Hospital's map traversable (F-G5-1)

local_validation.analytic_fixtures: 13/13 exact set agreement, 0 false negatives, 0 negative-control false positives
local_validation.known_hospital_objects: 5/5, 0 genuine false negatives after independent dense adjudication

no_further_tuning: This definition is frozen. It is not adjusted from Hospital route outcomes.
